slide_title: Effect of Selecting Threshold Value on Model Performance

layout.arrangement: A thin red rectangular frame encloses the entire slide content on a white background. The bold dark-red title is centered across the top inside the frame, with a yellow rounded-rectangle slide-number badge ('23') overlapping the frame at the top-right corner. The upper-left quadrant holds two confusion matrices (a small one at the very top-left and a larger, enlarged duplicate directly below it) plus a red-outlined 'Threshold=0.4' box to the right of the small matrix. The upper-right quadrant holds a wide rounded flowchart panel (pale-yellow fill, red border) running from roughly 33% to 88% of the slide width. The lower two-thirds of the slide is a one-dimensional strip/scatter plot: eleven grayscale cartoon airplane drawings, each carrying a small red or blue dot, are spread horizontally above a red horizontal number line running 0.0 to 1.0, with two closely spaced vertical dashed blue lines marking the threshold near 0.4. A black horizontal bar (video-player artifact) sits along the very bottom edge of the captured frame.

layout.hierarchy: The large bold dark-red title dominates by size and weight. Second in visual weight is the upper-right flowchart panel, whose saturated dark-red 'Model' block and bright yellow subtitle create the strongest color contrast. The two confusion matrices and the red 'Threshold=0.4' box form a secondary red/blue cluster at upper-left. The lower half is visually light and airy: thin gray airplane line art with tiny red/blue dots, anchored by the thin red number axis and the pair of dashed blue threshold lines.

visual_elements.description: Wide rounded-rectangle panel (pale cream fill, red border) showing a binary threshold-classification pipeline. Left to right: (1) black bold two-line label 'Test Sample' above a small grayscale sketch of a propeller airplane; (2) a white block arrow with red outline pointing right; (3) a dark-red filled rectangle labeled 'Model' in large white bold type, with the yellow text '(Any value → (0:+1))' beneath it, and a light-pink circle icon at the right end of the box divided by a vertical and horizontal line with the upper-right quadrant filled darker magenta (pie-chart symbol); (4) a white block arrow with red outline pointing right; (5) black bold two-line label 'Predicted Value' above a small rounded rectangle with blue border and blue text '(0 → -1)'; (6) a white block arrow with red outline pointing right; (7) a tall vertical rounded rectangle with pale pink fill and red border containing red bold rotated text 'Threshold (e.g. 0.5)' (read bottom-to-top); (8) two thin red arrows branching from the threshold box, the upper one pointing up-right to a green oval labeled 'Class I' and the lower one pointing down-right to a pink oval labeled 'Class II'.

Small confusion matrix (thumbnail). Red 'Predicted as' label centered above the grid; vertical red 'Actual' label to the left. Grid is 3 columns x 3 rows with red borders. Header row: empty corner cell, 'P' (blue), 'N' (blue). Row 'P' (blue): '4' (blue), '1' (red). Row 'N' (blue): '1' (red), '5' (blue).

Large confusion matrix (enlarged duplicate of the thumbnail). Red 'Predicted as' label above the grid; vertical red 'Actual' label at left. Grid 3x3 with red borders. Header row: empty corner cell, 'P' (blue), 'N' (blue). Row 'P' (blue): '4' (blue), '1' (red). Row 'N' (blue): '1' (red), '5' (blue).
White rectangle with a thin red border containing the bold red text 'Threshold=0.4'.

One-dimensional strip/scatter plot of airplane samples along a horizontal score axis. Horizontal axis: red line with arrowhead at the right end, running from 0.0 to 1.0, with 11 tick marks at 0.1 intervals; only three tick labels are printed, '0.0' (left), '0.5' (center), '1.0' (right), all in bold red. No vertical axis, no axis title, no gridlines. Two closely spaced vertical dashed blue lines straddle x = 0.40–0.41 (the threshold), running from about 37% to 91% of slide height. Eleven grayscale cartoon propeller airplanes are plotted at varying heights, each with a small colored dot: (1) x≈0.05, red dot, upper-left; (2) x≈0.25, red dot, mid-left; (3) x≈0.03, red dot, lower-left; (4) x≈0.17, red dot, lower-left; (5) x≈0.34, blue dot, upper-middle-left; (6) x≈0.37, red dot, middle; (7) x≈0.62, red dot, middle-right; (8) x≈0.55, blue dot, lower-middle; (9) x≈0.72, blue dot, mid-right; (10) x≈0.89, blue dot, upper-right; (11) x≈0.99, blue dot, lower-right. Six dots are red and five are blue as rendered.
Thin red rectangular border framing the whole slide content area, with the title inside it and the yellow slide-number badge overlapping its top-right corner.

typography_notes: All text is sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like). The title is large (~26–28 pt equivalent), bold, dark red, sentence case. The slide number '23' is small bold black on a yellow badge. Flowchart labels ('Test Sample', 'Predicted Value') are small bold black, set on two lines. 'Model' is large bold white on dark red; '(Any value → (0:+1))' is small yellow. '(0 → -1)' is small blue inside a blue-outlined rounded box. 'Threshold (e.g. 0.5)' is bold red, rotated 90° (reading bottom-to-top). 'Class I' / 'Class II' are small bold black inside colored ovals. Matrix headers 'P'/'N' and the values 4 and 5 are bold blue; the values 1 and 1 are bold red; 'Predicted as' and 'Actual' are bold red. 'Threshold=0.4' is bold red. Axis labels '0.0', '0.5', '1.0' are bold red. No bullets are used anywhere on the slide.
animation_state: The slide appears fully built: title, both confusion matrices, the threshold callout, the complete flowchart and the fully populated airplane strip plot are all visible simultaneously. The presence of the same confusion matrix twice (a small thumbnail at the very top-left and a larger enlarged copy below it) suggests a build/zoom animation in which the matrix was magnified, but no element appears half-drawn or partially revealed.
recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide size to 16:9 (900 x 482 px reference) with a plain white background; add a thin red (#C00000) rectangular outline inset about 6% from the left and right edges and about 8% from the top, extending to about 92% of the slide height.
2. Add the title 'Effect of Selecting Threshold Value on Model Performance' in bold Arial ~28 pt, color #C00000, horizontally centered across the top inside the frame (roughly x = 11%–85%, y = 9%–15%).
3. Add a yellow (#FFFF99) rounded rectangle at the top-right (~89%–93% width, ~9%–16% height) with black bold text '23' centered in it, letting it overlap the red frame.
4. Build the small confusion matrix at the top-left (~7.5%–14.5% width, ~16%–26% height): a 3x3 grid of thin red-bordered white cells; put 'Predicted as' in small bold red above the grid, 'Actual' in small bold red rotated 90° at the left; header row 'P' and 'N' in bold blue, row headers 'P' and 'N' in bold blue; data cells '4' (blue), '1' (red), '1' (red), '5' (blue).
5. To the right of that matrix, draw a white rectangle with red border (~19%–32% width, ~20%–25% height) containing bold red text 'Threshold=0.4'.
6. Build the larger duplicate confusion matrix below (~9%–24% width, ~27%–41% height) with the same red 'Predicted as' label above, vertical red 'Actual' label at left, blue P/N headers, and the same values 4 (blue), 1 (red), 1 (red), 5 (blue) in red-bordered cells.
7. Draw the flowchart panel: a wide rounded rectangle (~33%–88% width, ~18%–36% height) with pale cream fill (#FFFDE0) and red border.
8. Inside the panel, place the black bold two-line label 'Test Sample' above a small grayscale airplane sketch; add a white block arrow with red outline pointing right into the model block.
9. Add the dark-red (#A61C1C) 'Model' rectangle with large bold white 'Model' text, the small yellow '(Any value → (0:+1))' line beneath it, and a light-pink pie icon (circle with a darker magenta upper-right quadrant) at the box's right end.
10. Add another white/red-outlined block arrow pointing right; above it place the black bold two-line label 'Predicted Value'; add a small rounded rectangle with blue border and blue text '(0 → -1)'.
11. Add a third white/red-outlined block arrow pointing right into a tall vertical rounded rectangle (pale pink fill, red border) containing bold red rotated text 'Threshold (e.g. 0.5)'.
12. From the threshold box draw two thin red arrows: one up-right to a green (#B7E1CD) oval labeled 'Class I', one down-right to a pink (#FFC0E0) oval labeled 'Class II', both with small bold black text.
13. Draw the strip plot: a red horizontal line from x = 8.7% to 89.4% at y ≈ 79.5% with a right-pointing arrowhead, 11 red tick marks at 0.1 intervals, and bold red labels '0.0', '0.5', '1.0' beneath the left, center and right ticks.
14. Draw two closely spaced vertical dashed blue (#0000FF) lines at x ≈ 0.40 and 0.41 of the axis, extending from about 37% to 91% of slide height.
15. Place eleven grayscale cartoon propeller-airplane line drawings at the listed positions/heights, each with a tiny solid dot: red dots at x≈0.05 (upper-left), 0.25 (mid-left), 0.03 (lower-left), 0.17 (lower-left), 0.37 (middle) and 0.62 (middle-right); blue dots at x≈0.34 (upper-middle-left), 0.55 (lower-middle), 0.72 (mid-right), 0.89 (upper-right) and 0.99 (lower-right). Vary the planes' sizes and orientations slightly and keep them all above the axis.
16. Optionally reproduce the black horizontal bar at the very bottom of the frame if the video-player overlay must be matched.
